question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Abandon
solution:
The correct answer is '**Desert**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word is '**Desert**'.
 
• Explanation:
 
 
• **Perish** (नष्ट होना) - suffer death, typically in a violent, sudden, or untimely way.
 
• **Desert** (त्याग देना) - abandon (a person, cause, or organization) in a way considered disloyal or treacherous.
 
• **Prolong** (बढ़ाना) - extend the duration of.
 
• **Retain** (रखना) - continue to have (something); keep possession of.
 
 
 
• *Example sentence: "After the shipwreck, the survivors were forced to **desert** the sinking vessel and swim to safety."*
